about: Sight words, read-aloud sentences (the match headline, with its emoji), and one chant verse per step. Every other word must be in words.json at the sentence's step or earlier. In a chant, {Name} is a squad player's name and {act} or {Act} is one word from act, the same in every slot; a capital means the word starts a sentence. Tunes are public-domain nursery melodies, one word per note.
